frozen_manifest_unit.title: Nanodisc integration and validation role separation
frozen_manifest_unit.challenge_intent: Test whether a source claim of deriving and validating an ensemble supplies enough declared data-lineage facts for F06 labels.

source_first_pass_a.scientific_question: Does a statement that an ensemble was derived and validated by multimodal integration disclose enough lineage to label the validation independent?

source_identity_and_locators.citation: Bengtsen et al. (2020), Structure and dynamics of a nanodisc by integrating NMR, SAXS and SANS experiments with molecular dynamics simulations, eLife.

exact_pdf_locators.scope: two nanodiscs, SAXS/SANS with MD and prior NMR/EPR, and a derived/validated conformational ensemble.
nanodisc system context and intended integrative setting.

source_objects.native_observable: NMR, SAXS, SANS, EPR, and simulation components referenced in the source's integrative study.
source_objects.estimand: A nanodisc conformational ensemble and reconciled structural/dynamic description.
source_objects.statistical_unit: Two named nanodisc systems and their modality-specific source records.
source_objects.temporal_or_ensemble_semantics: Conformational heterogeneity is summarized as an ensemble.
source_objects.transformations_and_model_assumptions: An ensemble is derived by integrating experiments with MD and is described as validated, but the bounded abstract does not enumerate contribution or error lineage per modality.
source_objects.uncertainty_or_reliability_boundaries: The word 'validate' alone is insufficient to establish an independent-validation label.

atomic_source_supported_statements.statement: The abstract names SAXS/SANS, MD, and previously obtained NMR/EPR data in the study.
The abstract says the study derives and validates a conformational ensemble.

source_first_pass_a.source_relationship: This is an edge-level lineage challenge. It keeps source-local measurements intact while refusing to infer an independence label from summary wording.
source_first_pass_a.maximum_source_supported_wording: The cited abstract supports an integrative/validation description but leaves detailed data roles and shared-error structure unresolved in this bounded record.
forbidden_generalizations: Infer independent validation from the word 'validate'.
Treat multimodal integration as automatically comparable or linearly independent.
missing_information: Per-modality construction/fit/validation role, exact condition relation, and shared-error facts are not extracted.
possible_reusable_review_obligations: Require declared data lineage before an independence label.
Leave missing relation/bridge fields unresolved rather than generating a PASS.
source_first_pass_a.authority_boundary: Primary-source bounded record only; it does not establish annotation truth, source-science approval, Rule validity, or scientific support.

frozen_pattern_pass_b.applicability: Applicable edge in an integrative multimodal source relationship.
required_evidence: F06 source role and edge relation/lineage fields
dependency_chain: F06R02 needs relation, bridge, F02, and F03 prerequisites.
frozen_pattern_pass_b.first_blocking_dependency: The source summary lacks declared per-input role and lineage fields.
frozen_pattern_pass_b.local_claim_ceiling: The pattern records a missing lineage question; it does not judge the ensemble or methods scientifically.
irrelevant_obligations: No automatic source lookup or operator is run.

analyst_divergence_classification_before.claim_boundary: The analyst records a projection, not a RuleResult or scientific conclusion.
